budget_items.topic: Brooks House demolition and moving costs (Tappe study)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Adams cited the Tappe study's estimates for demolishing the Brooks House and for moving it; McQuaid said the study was for restoring buildings to current use and did not really apply.
